tasks.label: redis: start (selfservice)
tasks.command: if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew services start redis; else redis-cli ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || redis-server --daemonize yes; fi

tasks.label: redis: stop (selfservice)
tasks.command: if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew services stop redis; else redis-cli shutdown >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
